description: This file defines the DateTimeResult class that extends PHP's DateTime to provide custom creation methods from epoch and ISO8601 timestamps, with enhanced precision handling for JSON serialization and string representation within the AWS SDK.

classes.name: DateTimeResult
classes.description: A subclass of DateTime that supports creation from epoch and ISO8601 timestamps with microsecond and nanosecond precision, suitable for AWS SDK internal use.

methods.name: fromEpoch
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult instance from a Unix epoch timestamp, supporting microsecond precision if available.

methods.name: fromISO8601
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult instance from an ISO8601 timestamp string, with handling for nanosecond precision depending on PHP version.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult instance from various timestamp formats, attempting ISO8601, Unix timestamp, or epoch as fallback.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the DateTimeResult as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the DateTimeResult as an ISO 8601 string for JSON encoding.
